fields.heading: National Health
fields.description: A unified digital health platform connecting patients, doctors, hospitals, laboratories, pharmacies, and government health authorities across Bangladesh. Secure, interoperable, and designed to improve healthcare outcomes for every citizen.

fields.title: Electronic Health Records
fields.description: Securely store, manage, and access complete patient medical histories, including diagnoses, treatments, medications, and allergies, from any authorized healthcare facility nationwide.

fields.title: Electronic Medical Records
fields.description: Comprehensive digital records for each patient, capturing clinical encounters, laboratory results, imaging reports, and treatment plans in a structured, searchable format.

fields.title: Digital Health ID
fields.description: Every citizen receives a unique digital health identifier that links all health records, enabling seamless access to medical history across hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies.

fields.title: Patient Management
fields.description: Efficiently register, update, and maintain patient demographics, contact details, insurance information, and emergency contacts for comprehensive care coordination.

fields.title: Doctor Management
fields.description: Manage doctor profiles, specialties, qualifications, schedules, and affiliated hospitals, ensuring patients can find and connect with the right healthcare provider.

fields.title: Hospital Management
fields.description: Centralized management of hospitals, including facility details, departments, bed availability, and contact information, enabling efficient healthcare delivery.

fields.title: Department Management
fields.description: Organize hospital departments (Cardiology, Neurology, Pediatrics, etc.) with detailed services, staff, and operational hours for improved patient routing.

fields.title: Appointment Booking
fields.description: Patients can easily schedule appointments with doctors at preferred hospitals, choosing available time slots and receiving instant confirmations.

fields.title: Appointment Tracking
fields.description: Real-time tracking of appointment status—confirmed, visited, cancelled—with reminders and notifications to keep patients informed.

fields.title: e‑Prescription
fields.description: Doctors can generate digital prescriptions with medicine names, dosages, frequency, and duration; patients receive them instantly on their health ID.

fields.title: Prescription QR Code
fields.description: Every e‑prescription comes with a unique QR code that pharmacies can scan to verify authenticity and dispense medicines accurately.

fields.title: Laboratory Management
fields.description: Manage lab test catalogs, sample collection, test results, and integrate with EHRs to provide a complete diagnostic view for clinicians.

fields.title: Digital Lab Reports
fields.description: Laboratory reports are digitized, securely stored, and immediately accessible to patients and doctors, eliminating physical paperwork.

fields.title: Pharmacy Management
fields.description: Centralized pharmacy inventory, prescription processing, and medicine dispensing, ensuring patients receive the right medication at the right time.

fields.title: Medicine Dispensing
fields.description: Pharmacists can verify e‑prescriptions, dispense medicines, and update patient medication history for better continuity of care.

fields.title: Vaccination Records
fields.description: Maintain lifetime vaccination history for every citizen, including childhood immunizations, COVID-19 shots, and booster doses.

fields.title: Allergy Management
fields.description: Record and manage patient allergies to medications, foods, and environmental triggers, alerting clinicians during prescribing to avoid adverse reactions.

fields.title: Chronic Disease Tracking
fields.description: Comprehensive tracking of chronic conditions like diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease, with monitoring of key indicators over time.

fields.title: Emergency Access
fields.description: In critical situations, healthcare providers can instantly access a patient's vital medical history, allergies, and emergency contacts through the system.

fields.title: Secure Data Sharing
fields.description: Authorized healthcare institutions can exchange patient data securely using end‑to‑end encryption, with full audit trails and consent management.

fields.title: Medical History Timeline
fields.description: Visualize a patient's complete medical journey in chronological order, from childhood vaccinations to recent hospitalizations and surgeries.

fields.title: Notification System
fields.description: Automated alerts for appointment reminders, prescription renewal, lab results, and health campaigns delivered via email, SMS, or in‑app notifications.

fields.title: Email Notifications
fields.description: Send secure email notifications to patients and healthcare providers for account activity, health reminders, and system updates.

fields.title: Medical Document Upload
fields.description: Patients and doctors can upload medical documents, reports, and images directly to the patient’s record for comprehensive documentation.

fields.title: PDF Report Download
fields.description: Generate and download comprehensive health reports, prescriptions, and lab results in PDF format for printing or offline use.

fields.title: Dashboard Analytics
fields.description: Interactive dashboards with charts and graphs for healthcare administrators to monitor key performance indicators and resource utilization.

fields.title: Healthcare Statistics
fields.description: Aggregate and visualize nationwide healthcare statistics to identify trends, allocate resources, and improve public health strategies.

fields.title: Government Monitoring
fields.description: Authorized health officials can monitor disease outbreaks, vaccination coverage, hospital capacity, and other critical public health metrics in real time.

fields.title: Audit Logs
fields.description: Maintain a complete audit trail of all system activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and compliance with data protection regulations.

fields.title: Hospital Directory
fields.description: A comprehensive, searchable directory of all hospitals in Bangladesh, including contact information, specialties, and available services.

fields.title: Search Patients
fields.description: Quickly find patient records by name, national ID, health ID, or other unique identifiers across the entire national database.

fields.title: Search Doctors
fields.description: Find doctors by name, specialty, hospital affiliation, or location, facilitating patient access to the right healthcare provider.

fields.title: Search Hospitals
fields.description: Find hospitals by name, location, or available specialties, assisting patients in choosing the nearest or most appropriate facility.

fields.title: Search Medical Records
fields.description: A powerful search engine that allows clinicians to retrieve specific clinical data, lab results, or imaging reports across the entire patient record.

fields.title: Multi-Hospital Integration
fields.description: Seamless integration across multiple hospitals and healthcare institutions, enabling continuous care and data sharing even when patients move between facilities.

fields.title: National Health Database
fields.description: The central repository that aggregates anonymized health data to support national health policy, epidemiological research, and resource planning.

fields.title: API Ready
fields.description: Full RESTful API support for third-party integrations, mobile applications, and future expansion, following FHIR and industry best practices.

fields.title: Responsive Dashboard
fields.description: A fully responsive, mobile-friendly dashboard that adapts to any screen size, ensuring healthcare professionals can access data from any device.

fields.title: Role‑Based Access Control
fields.description: Granular permission settings for different user roles—admins, doctors, patients, lab staff, pharmacists—ensuring data is accessible only to those with authorization.

fields.title: Citizen Health Portal
fields.description: A dedicated patient portal where citizens can view their health records, book appointments, download prescriptions, and communicate with healthcare providers.

fields.title: Digital Healthcare
fields.description: Complete digitization of healthcare services from registration to treatment, reducing paperwork and increasing efficiency.

fields.title: Secure Authentication
fields.description: Multi‑factor authentication, encrypted passwords, and session management to protect user accounts and sensitive health data.

fields.title: Role‑Based Access
fields.description: Customizable permission sets for administrators, clinicians, patients, and support staff to enforce least‑privilege access.

fields.title: Fast Search
fields.description: Lightning‑fast, intelligent search across all patient records, appointments, prescriptions, and laboratory data.

fields.title: Analytics Dashboard
fields.description: Comprehensive visual dashboards with real‑time metrics, trend analysis, and predictive insights for healthcare administrators.

fields.title: National Database
fields.description: A unified, centralized database that consolidates health records from all regions, enabling holistic patient care and national health planning.

fields.title: QR Verification
fields.description: Quick Response (QR) codes on prescriptions and patient IDs ensure fast, tamper‑proof verification at pharmacies and clinics.

fields.title: Cloud Ready
fields.description: Architected for cloud deployment, ensuring high availability, automatic scaling, and disaster recovery for uninterrupted service.

fields.title: Unified National Health Database
fields.description: All patient records, prescriptions, lab reports, and medical histories are stored in a single, secure, and centralized system accessible across the country.

fields.title: Enhanced Patient Care
fields.description: With complete medical history available instantly, doctors can make better-informed decisions, reduce diagnostic errors, and provide personalized treatments.

fields.title: Secure and Private
fields.description: Advanced encryption, role-based access controls, and strict authentication ensure that patient data is protected and shared only with authorized personnel.

fields.title: Interoperability and Integration
fields.description: Seamless communication between hospitals, clinics, labs, pharmacies, and government health authorities eliminates data silos and enables coordinated care.

fields.title: Real‑Time Analytics
fields.description: Public health officials can monitor disease outbreaks, track vaccination coverage, and generate actionable insights to improve national health policies.

fields.title: Citizen Empowerment
fields.description: Patients can access their own health records, schedule appointments, receive digital prescriptions, and take charge of their health journey from anywhere.

fields.name: Mrs. Nasrin Akhter

fields.name: Dr. Shahida Khan
fields.designation: Director, National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases
fields.content: The centralized database allows us to track chronic diseases like heart conditions more effectively. It's a powerful tool for research and public health monitoring.

fields.question: What is NHIMS?
fields.answer: NHIMS (National Health Information Management System) is a digital platform developed by the Government of Bangladesh to unify and manage healthcare data across the country, ensuring secure, efficient, and accessible health services for every citizen.

fields.question: Who can use NHIMS?
fields.answer: NHIMS is designed for all stakeholders in the healthcare ecosystem: patients, doctors, hospital administrators, laboratory staff, pharmacists, and government health authorities. Each role has tailored access and permissions.

fields.question: Is my health data secure?
fields.answer: Absolutely. NHIMS uses enterprise‑grade encryption, role‑based access control, and comprehensive audit trails. Data is stored in compliance with national and international privacy standards.

fields.question: How can I access my health records?
fields.answer: All citizens with a valid Digital Health ID can log in to the citizen portal using their credentials. From there, you can view your medical history, prescriptions, lab reports, and more.

fields.question: What if I visit a hospital that is not part of the network?
fields.answer: NHIMS is a national initiative, and all government and major private hospitals are being onboarded. Even if a hospital is not yet integrated, you can still access your records from any connected facility.

fields.question: How does NHIMS help doctors?
fields.answer: Doctors get a complete view of the patient's history—past diagnoses, medications, allergies, and lab results—enabling faster, more accurate decisions and better treatment outcomes.
